FULL TEXT:
COMPUTER OPERATOR-CUM-TYPIST RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2026
NOTICE
No.- 44/R&A Dated: 29th July, 2026
This is for information to all concerned that Computer Based Written Test
(comprising MCQ, English Computer Typing Test and Hindi Computer Typing Test) under
the Computer Operator-cum-Typist Recruitment Examination, 2026 (Advertisement No.
PHC/02/2026) was held on 22.07.2026 (Wednesday) in two shifts at 18 examination centres
situated in Patna & Muzaffarpur.
The provisional Model Answer Keys alongwith Candidates’ Response of the
Multiple Choice Questions have been uploaded on the official website of the High Court i.e.
https://patnahighcourt.gov.in/notices/recruitments. Candidates who have appeared in the
aforesaid test may login through the provided link and click the ‘Answer Key and
Response’ tab for viewing the model answer keys alongwith their respective answers
submitted in the test.
A candidate, who has appeared in this examination and wishes to raise an objection
regarding any question and/or the Model Answer, may submit an objection through the link
available on the official website of the High Court from 30.07.2026 (12:00 p.m.) to
06.08.2026 (12:00 p.m.). The objection must be supported by a copy of authentic source
document(s)/proof on the basis of which it is being submitted.
Candidates shall be required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹50/- (Rupees Fifty
only) per objection raised, through online mode.
Any objection received without any authentic proof/source and/or the prescribed fee
and after the stipulated time or through any other mode than the one as prescribed in this
notice shall not be entertained/considered on any ground whatsoever and shall stand
rejected automatically without assigning any reason.
P a g e | 2
The provisional Model Answer Key shall be finalized after considering the valid
objections received and the same shall be used as final Model Answer for generating the
result of the Computer Operator-cum-Typist Recruitment Examination, 2026. No
representation regarding any question or the provisional Model Answer shall be
entertained after the closing date for submission of objections and any such representation
shall stand rejected without assigning any reason. In the event of non-receipt of any
objection, the provisional Model Answer Key published herewith shall be deemed final and
the result shall be generated accordingly.
The decision of the High Court of Judicature at Patna on the objections shall be
final and no further correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website regularly for further
details/updates
By order
Sd/-
Registrar General
